create_splinter_tokenizer: create a SplinterTokenizer instance with custom vocab, lower case, and special tokens for question answering
load_vocab_file: load a WordPiece vocabulary file into an ordered dictionary mapping tokens to integer indices
test_splinter_tokenizer_post_processor: test the SplinterTokenizer post processor with single and pair sequences using template processing
build_splinter_question_token_id: build the question token ID property from the SplinterTokenizer special token configuration
refactor_splinter_tokenizer_normalizer: refactor the SplinterTokenizer normalizer to configure BertNormalizer with chinese char tokenization and accent stripping
